text:
sam_partners: quick ask for the marketplace/pricing model: can vendors give the exact commit breakpoints (GPU-hrs tiers) that unlock deeper discounts and whether those discounts stack with marketplace promo credits? need by COB Mon.

wei_vendor: summary here. breakpoints = 5k / 25k / 100k GPU-hrs per month. discounts (off list): 1) 5k -> 22%, 2) 25k -> 35%, 3) 100k -> 55%. marketplace promo is separate and applied on invoice; we allow pass-through but require the addendum. discounts do NOT stack multiplicatively; you get the single tier that matches volume.

marta_fin: please give effective USD/GPU-hr numbers after discount but before promo credit, and also a conservative spot price (we'll model spot usable% = vendor_claim * 0.75).

wei_vendor: quick table: NA before $0.72 -> 5k $0.56 / 25k $0.47 / 100k $0.32; spot nominal $0.25 (vol +/-50%); lead time for reserved pool = 5 weeks; preemption notice = 90s.

devon_ops: ops asks: 1) are reserved pools soft or hard? 2) any per-region blackout windows? 3) can we subscribe to preemption webhook?

wei_vendor: reserved = soft (burst allowed if spare). APAC has occasional quarterly infra maintenance (48h windows) we mark as reduced spot depth. webhook = yes, optional.

legals-bot: reminder: pass-through requires signed addendum. template at https://contracts.redwood.example/addenda.

sam_partners: action: wei to upload CSV with per-region tiers + lead times + spot volatility (COB Mon). marta to normalize to GPU-hr effective costs (Tue). devon to add routing note for APAC maintenance (RFC).

sam_partners: thanks all :thumbsup:
